title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Plan Schedule: Price Structure and Term
content:
Commercial Natural Gas Supply is sold in six plans. Each plan fixes how the price per therm is built, how long the term runs and whether the price may move during the term to pass through a change in law or regulation. The schedule below is the reference for those terms on every plan.

## Schedule

| Plan | Pricing structure | Term (months) | NYMEX component floats monthly | Delivered basis locked for the term | Beacon Ridge adder locked for the term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | Index | 0 (month-to-month) | Yes | No | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | Fixed basis | 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Fixed | 12 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | Fixed | 24 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Fixed | 36 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Fixed | 24 | No | Yes | Yes |

## Price notice and pass-through terms

| Plan | Monthly price notice that prices a billing cycle | Regulatory pass-through permitted during the term | Minimum notice before a pass-through takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | The notice for the month of the billing period start | No | 30 calendar days |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | The notice for the month of the billing period start | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | The notice for the month of the billing period start | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | The notice for the month of the billing period start | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | The notice for the month of the billing period start | No | 30 calendar days |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | The notice for the month of the billing period start | No | 30 calendar days |

## Reading the schedule

- **Pricing structure.** An index plan floats with the month's delivered index price; a fixed basis plan floats only with the NYMEX component; a fixed plan carries one all-in price.
- **Term.** A term of 0 months means the plan is month-to-month and has no contract end date. The Fixed Basis 12 and Fixed 12 plans run 12 months, the Fixed 24 and Carbon Neutral 24 plans run 24 months and the Fixed 36 plan runs 36 months.
- **Locked components.** The Beacon Ridge adder is locked for the term on all six plans. The delivered basis is locked on every plan except the Monthly Index plan.
- **Pass-through.** Only the Fixed Basis 12, Fixed 12 and Fixed 24 plans permit a regulatory pass-through during the term. The minimum notice period of 30 calendar days is the same on every plan.

## Points of reference

**Which Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas plans float with NYMEX?** The Monthly Index plan and the Fixed Basis 12 plan. On the four all-in fixed plans the NYMEX component does not float.

**Which plans have no term?** Only the Monthly Index plan, whose term is 0 months.
